description: PFC converter. Watch current distortion, voltage-loop instability at 2*f_line, and inrush current.

pathologies.explanation: Output oscillates near 2*f_line — voltage-loop bandwidth is too high and injecting ripple into the current reference. Reduce voltage-loop bandwidth below 2*f_line.
Large initial spike — inrush current at startup. The bulk capacitor charges through the boost inductor with no current limit. Add pre-charge resistor or soft-start ramp.
Output has high ripple at line harmonics — current-loop bandwidth too low causing THD. Increase current-loop bandwidth.
Output never approaches target — implementation error (current reference not generated, or voltage sensor polarity wrong).
